 MATCH PREVIEW, pres. by Toyota: Red Bull New York Host Inter Miami CF on Saturday Afternoon at Sports Illustrated Stadium
 Red Bull New York Communications
 Copy URL 
 Share on Facebook 
 Share on X 
 Red Bull New York (10-14-6, 36 pts.) host Inter Miami CF (15-5-10, 55 pts.) at Sports Illustrated Stadium on Saturday, October 24.
 Kickoff is set for 5:30 p.m. ET with coverage on Apple TV in English and Spanish, and Red Bulls Radio in English via the Red Bull New York app and RedBullNewYork.com.
 Coverage on Apple TV begins at 5:30 p.m. ET. Keith Costigan will have primary play-by-play responsibilities and will be alongside Maurice Edu on the English side, while Alejandro Figueredo will have the play-by-play responsibilities and will be alongside Tony Cherchi on the Spanish side.
 Red Bulls Radio presented by Sports Illustrated begins at 5 p.m. ET with Countdown to Kickoff, presented by Toyota, hosted by Matt Harmon and Steve Jolley.
MLS on Apple TV 
 Every club, every match, everywhere. Fans can stream every MLS match, for every club with an Apple TV subscription, with no local blackouts — ever.
 WATCH: RBNY vs. Inter Miami CF 
 Club Room 
 This will be the 14th all-time regular season meeting between New York and Miami, with the series tied, both teams recording a 6-6-1 mark. The Red Bulls have posted a 2-3-0 mark in their last five matches. New York earned a result on April 11 against Inter Miami CF in a 2-2 draw on the road.
 Winger Jorge Ruvalcaba scored in the match, and he has also recorded two goal contributions in his last two matches at Sports Illustrated Stadium.
 Red Bulls midfielder Adri Mehmeti scored his first career MLS goal the last time the two clubs met on April 11 at Nu Stadium. This season, Mehmeti has also recorded six assists at only 17-years-old.
 Goalkeeper Ethan Horvath made five saves in the match on April 11, and his 103 saves on the season, ranks ninth in MLS.​
Red Bulls Radio 
 Listen to every match, live, on Red Bulls Radio! Veteran soccer play-by-play voice Matt Harmon will handle the broadcasts alongside former club standout Steve Jolley providing color commentary.
 Listen Now 
 Following Saturday’s match, New York will embark on a two-match road trip, beginning with a midweek matchup against New England Revolution on Wednesday, October 28 at Gillette Stadium. Kickoff is set for 7:30 p.m. ET with coverage on Apple TV in English and Spanish, and Red Bulls Radio in English via the Red Bull New York app and RedBullNewYork.com.
